_doc: Soft map edges per live zone. margin: tiles from the edge where the vignette starts; line: Glauka's line at an edge (per side n/e/s/w or default); noise: sides with the ring road (traffic synth); bounce: signpost bounce lines by kind.

athens.default: That way lies the modern city. The stories are this way!

sides.s: That way is the road to Piraeus and the sea. Use the signpost if you want to sail!
sides.w: That way lies the modern city. The stories are this way!

academy.default: The busy road is out there. The Academy's olive grove is this way!

syntagma.default: The busy avenues are out there. The square and the Parliament are this way!

lyceum.default: The city is that way. Aristotle's walking paths are over here!

city: That way lies the modern city (Syntagma Square, parliament and traffic). It is not in this game yet. The stories are this way!
